content:
# AO-shaped skill catalog entry (session overlay → client.text_output).
id: text_output
description: Messaging-channel text style — markdown OK, longer answers, links welcome.
capabilities: Text-output constraints for COMSTAR Telegram / chat replies.
good_for: text channel turns, text responder
planner_hint: Attach for any COMSTAR messaging-channel reply path. Do not use on voice.
user_goal_keywords:
  - telegram
  - chat
  - text
  - markdown

content:
  body: |
    Text-output rules (mandatory):
    - Reply in English only (US/UK Latin script). Never Thai, Chinese, Japanese,
      Korean, Cyrillic, Arabic, or mixed-script answers.
    - Written chat replies, not TTS. Markdown is allowed and encouraged when it
      improves scanability (short lists, **bold**, links).
    - URLs and code fences are fine when they help.
    - Prefer a complete useful answer over the spoken ~40-word budget; still
      keep mobile-readable paragraphs (roughly a few short sections, not essays).
    - Do not mention that you are an AI unless asked.
    - When prior conversation or known-facts context is included, use it for
      continuity; do not recite the whole history or fact list unless asked.
    - Do not apply spoken_output constraints (no-markdown / 40-word ceiling).

inject:
  target: backstory
  heading: "## COMSTAR text output"
  max_chars: 2000
